_comment: Editable game content. Change points, quests, messages here — no code edit needed. Reload the app to pick up changes.

flock._comment: Multiple individuals of the same species in one photo. Each extra animal is worth less than the last (diminishing), but more animals always beats fewer. base * sum of (decay^i) for i=0..n-1.

coop._comment: Two users logging the SAME species within window_min and coop_km both get bonus.

messages.not_wildlife: Hmm — that doesn't look like Finnish wildlife. No points for that one!
messages.low_conf: Not sure what that is — confirm the species to log it.
messages.from_library: Logged from your library (no freshness bonus).
messages.new_area: First sighting in this area — bonus!
messages.unknown_species: That species isn't in the Finnish field guide yet, so it won't be added to your journal.

messages_fi.not_wildlife: Hmm — tämä ei näytä suomalaiselta luonnoneläimeltä. Ei pisteitä tästä!
messages_fi.low_conf: En ole varma mikä tämä on — vahvista laji kirjataksesi sen.
messages_fi.unknown_species: Tätä lajia ei vielä ole suomalaisessa lajiluettelossa, joten sitä ei lisätä päiväkirjaasi.
